Rae (Marketing): Heads-up: webinar on 2026-04-12. Need X + LinkedIn teaser schedule, 2 short X threads (4 tweets each), a 20s clip, and a GIF. Test creative: Variant A (benchmarks + chart), Variant B (customer story). Goal: CTR to reg page and # of high-intent replies. Who owns what?

Noah (Social): I'll own scheduling and replies. Proposal: X A -> 2026-04-08 15:00 UTC, LinkedIn B -> 2026-04-09 18:00 UTC, X B -> 2026-04-10 15:00 UTC, LinkedIn A -> 2026-04-11 18:00 UTC. Will pin top reply with reg link for 48h. Shortlink: rdw.ai/webinar0426.

Lina (Content): Ill draft: 2 X threads (4 tweets each), 2 LinkedIn drafts (long + TL;DR), reply templates. Upload to Drive /Marketing/Events/webinar-apr-2026/assets by 2026-04-01 12:00 PT. Assets: hero_1200x628.png, clip20s_v1.mp4, gif_v1.gif.

Marco (Growth): Routing plan: Zapier -> HubSpot. Name: webinar_social_apr26. Triage: regex /(pricing|demo|enterprise|rfp|trial)/i => high-intent. If follower_count > 500 or company domain in bio => medium. UTM: utm_source=twitter|linkedin&utm_campaign=webinar_apr26&utm_content={variant}. I'll push the Zap mapping today.

ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance 2026-04-07 08:00-12:00 UTC; avoid scheduling then. Confirm music license and recorded consent by 2026-04-02. Registration consent checkbox: TRUE.

Noah (Social): Engagement playbook: 1) two follow-up replies within 24h (slide snippet + CTA), 2) auto-DM for exact-match keywords (demo/pricing) to collect contact, 3) mute spam-looking replies. I'll set auto-DM to: "Thanks! Please DM your email or register rdw.ai/webinar0426 and our SDR will follow up."

Lina (Content): Reply templates (pick per signal): - Low-intent: "Thanks! Register: rdw.ai/webinar0426  recording sent to registrants." - Tech Q: "Good Q  we cover perf tradeoffs and routing in the demo. Slides: rdw.ai/slides0426" - Sales: "Sounds like a fit  can our SDR reach out? DM your email or register and we'll prioritize follow-up."

Marco (Growth): Regex to drop into Zapier filters:
```
/(pricing|demo|trial|enterprise|rfp|purchase)/i
```
I'll add boosting: comments with >1 keyword or company domain bump to top priority.

Rae (Marketing): Action items: Lina uploads drafts + assets by 4/1 12:00 PT; Noah queues posts and shares Sprout links; Marco shares Zapier mapping; ops-bot confirms license by 4/2. Quick check 2026-04-02 10:00 PT. Thanks! :rocket:
